verdict.rationale: x402 is designed exactly for this: one line of code returns HTTP 402, agents sign and retry payment, and the CDP Facilitator settles onchain without any checkout UI, with real-world builders (httpay.xyz, Apiosk) confirming server-side monetization in production. missing for 10: independent large-scale case studies beyond a couple community builders, and clearer proof that agents themselves (not just backend integrators) autonomously complete payment without any human wallet-approval step in practice.
